about_the_game:
About the Demo:

Play the start of a (hopefully) peaceful adventure in the demo before exploring (and maybe destroying) the whole world in the full game!

The demo contains the introductory part of the game's story, has only one of the playable characters available for use, restricts travel to early areas of the game, and only has auto-saves lacking the manual save option from the full-version. Save data will not transfer to the full-version of the game, but players can use that as an opportunity to try playing through the intro in a different way.

About the Full Game:

The proble- er- story so far...

Haryun is the son of the venerated hero Harold which is a bit of a problem since Harold was also the one who taught him the sword. Why would learning the sword from a hero be a problem? Because, he was so powerful that the kingdom forced him into retirement!!!

So, now he needs to save his childhood friend (from some illness or something; it's probably not too serious anyway). On his journey Haryun will (peacefully?) solve many problems and work together with an incredibly powerful witch!

(Player plays the game here.)

The end.

(Anti-)Features

  • Attack: You can make a super-duper extra over-powered attack which will make you level up and only increase the damage further! (The attack preparations shorten as your level increases.)

  • Talk: Let's pleeease settle this peacefully!

  • Look: I promise this isn't just a slightly different thing from Talk... I mean you use your eyes.

  • Forgiving difficulty: Maps reset because they're probably never more than a little damaged.

  • Unforgiving difficulty: Attacked the wrong person? Too bad you'll never know. Just give up and ask for some forgiveness (the only forgiving option is to change the difficulty).

  • More: There's a menu, the game saves, and all kinds of other things you normally find in games!

short_description: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!
